title: Todo Worklist and Manual Mail Authorization

items.action: view todo worklist and modal context
record worklist activity against an existing todo
send manual task mail from the todo worklist

migration.reason: All required permissions already exist in the companion Core authorization catalog.

notes: Worklist activity mutates an existing Todo and therefore requires fair_crm.todos.update, never fair_crm.todos.create. Manual Mail is a mail-send side effect and therefore requires fair_crm.mail_send_operations.execute independently of Todo create/update. The UI keeps the read-only worklist context visible while hiding activity mutation controls without Todo update and hiding Manual Mail without mail-send execute. fair_crm.todos.execute is intentionally not introduced. Prod-path E2E resolves a matching Core head branch first and then the Fair PR base branch, allowing stacked Fair authorization PRs to test against their stacked Core dependency.
